rows.detail: Top-level docs align to actual Core 1.3 repo reality.
Existing Core 1.3 science bundle remains internally consistent.
Current Cerberus latest bundle is head-synced and clean only when the status is RELEASE_SAFE.
build_core.sh no longer tolerates validator or build-critical drift.
CI build produces validated public release artifacts.
Tag release reads deterministic assets and requires a release-safe gate cert.
Reproducibility archive contract is explicit and includes workflow provenance.
Declared public/private mirror parity is machine-detectable.
